video.title: AI欧腐《爱上前任暗恋的他/Falling for my ex's crush》
video.desc:
Noah is dumped by his vain girlfriend Chloe. Seeing his ex trying to latch onto wealthy Alexander, Noah hatches a revenge plan: seduce Alexander and shatter Chloe’s dream of marrying into riches.He becomes Alexander’s assistant. While pursuing him under false pretenses, genuine feelings gradually blossom, and they fall for each other.
Noah被爱慕虚荣的女友Chloe抛弃。看到前任试图攀上富有的Alexander，Noah制定了一个复仇计划：勾引Alexander，粉碎Chloe嫁入豪门的美梦。
他成为了Alexander的助理。起初，他带着虚假的目的接近对方；可在追求的过程中，真挚的感情逐渐萌芽，两人最终爱上了彼此。
